An '''Ewok village''' existed around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], located on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. The village was lead by a [[Unidentified Ewok chief|chieftain]] and consisted of various other [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. At some point the village came to be terrorized by a beast known as the [[Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain]]. Eventually the creature was killed by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]. The fight and it's participants, including a [[Limb/Legends|limbless]] [[Unidentified B1 battle droid (Endor)|B1 battle]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|droid]], were all later immortalized in a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] created by the chieftain.<ref name="what goes up" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[City/Legends|village]] first appeared in [[What Goes Up... (comic story)|''What Goes Up...'']], a short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] collected in ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 5]]'' and written and illustrated by the [[Fillbach Brothers]]. The events of the comic were later in referenced in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Pablo Hidalgo]], [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Bob Vitas]].<ref name="what goes up" />
